newsitem.title: JAPAN: BANOCO '97 term naphtha premium at $11.00 - traders.
newsitem.headline: BANOCO '97 term naphtha premium at $11.00 - traders.

text.p: Bahrain National Oil Co (BANOCO) and Japanese naphtha lifters have agreed to set a term premium for 1997 at $11.00 over the mean of Middle Eastern quotes, traders said on Monday.
The new price compares with a $6.25 premium for 1996.
BANOCO's term naphtha will have two prices next year.
The supplier earlier this year set an $8.45 premium for additional 1997 cargoes for some Asian buyers, they said.
The lower premium will be applied mainly to new buyers, and the higher premium mainly to existing buyers.
Japanese trading houses are expected to import about 800,000 tonnes of term cargoes from BANOCO next year and South Korean firms about 200,000 tonnes, they added.
